tool.name: qiime2 sidle reconstruct-fragment-rep-seqs
tool.description: Reconstract representative sequences for shared fragments.
tool.command: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="\$PWD/xdgconfig" MPLCONFIGDIR="\$PWD/mplconfigdir" NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/numbacache" CONDA_PREFIX=/opt/conda/envs/sidle-0.1.0-beta && q2galaxy run sidle reconstruct_fragment_rep_seqs '$inputs'

param.name: reconstruction_map
param.label: reconstruction_map: FeatureData[SidleReconstruction]
param.help: [required] A map between the final kmer name and the original database sequence. Useful for reconstructing taxonomy and trees.

param.name: reconstruction_summary
param.label: reconstruction_summary: FeatureData[ReconstructionSummary]
param.help: [required] A summary of the statitics for the regional map describing the number of regions mapped to each reference sequence and the number of kmers. The kmer mapping estimate can account for degeneracy when the `--count-degenerates` flag is used or can ignore degenrate sequences in mapping.

param.name: aligned_sequences
param.label: aligned_sequences: FeatureData[AlignedSequence]
param.help: [required] The aligned representative sequences corresponding to the database used in reconstruction.

tool.help:
QIIME 2: sidle reconstruct-fragment-rep-seqs ============================================ Reconstract representative sequences for shared fragments.
Outputs: -------- :representative_fragments.qza: The consensus sequence fragments to be used for fragment insertion.
|
Description: ------------ EXPERIMENTAL!!! This function simulates a represenative sequence for reference regions that are derived from multiple sequences to allow tree building via fragment insertion. The function will find the consensus sequence for all the database regions covered between the amplicons.
|
